_about: Feeds the platform counters on index.html (every element with a data-snap attribute). Written by the export job on the platform server; never edited by hand once live. live=false leaves the typed values on the page untouched. When the job writes real readings, it sets live=true and as_of to the reading time in UTC (ISO 8601, ending in Z). A reading older than max_age_hours is shown with its date in place of 'Live'. Totals only: no entity names, scores or ranks belong in this file.
